_comment: ngsolve plasticity#5 (multiplicative F = Fe*Fp vs additive eps = eps_e + eps_p). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.4 VectorH1 order 2, Integrate(..., order=6): the small-strain additive Cauchy stress and the Neo-Hookean push-forward from Fe = F*Inv(Fp) drift apart monotonically with engineering strain (about 1% at 1% strain, 3.9% at 5%, 11.6% at 20%, 15.3% at 30%) and the gap tracks |1/Det(F) - 1| to within a factor well under 2 -- the claim's stated order. Det(Fe)*Det(Fp) == Det(F) and Cof(F) == Det(F)*Inv(F).trans hold to machine precision.
